title: Tribal Instinct
description:
Since childhood you have hunted the volcanic galleries of your Yurta for the beasts that shelter in the ash.

The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} {{INSTRI-001|this Skill}}, choose an {{aptitude}} from {{survie}} and {{nature}}. While {{INSTRI-001|this Skill}} is {{memorisee}}, you have {{expertise}} in that {{aptitude}}.
